name: tisty
description: Shared working memory for you and your AI agent: notes, documents and tasks in local Markdown, with task steps, a dated journal and an Ideas sheet. Your agent picks up where it left off and reads a section at a time, where you can follow and audit it. It works without an agent too, the traditional way: your notes, documents and tasks, by hand and at your own pace. Requires the free Tisty app for Windows or macOS.
